name: Portfolio construction

description.model: Drafts a target portfolio: weights, bands, cash and exits in the envelope. Use when a Zoom out proposes target_portfolio@1.
description.marketplace: Turns the cycle's theses into a target portfolio the platform's runner can follow: a weight per position from its fair weight and the pool's depth, a band, a cash target and an exit plan, all inside the goal's envelope and the owner's limits. Tunes the platform's target_portfolio@1 template; the runner makes the trades.

triggers: drafting or revising a target portfolio
choosing a position's weight, band, cash target or exit plan
